CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListContains

Returns the position of the first element of a list that contains the given text anywhere inside it. The search is case-sensitive. If no element contains the text, the result is 0.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListContains(list, substring [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to search.
substring
The text to look for inside each element.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma.

Returns

The index of the first matching element, or 0.

Usage

ListContains matches part of an element: "bar" is found in "crowbar". To match whole elements only, use ListFind. ListContainsNoCase ignores case.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Tools = "hammer,crowbar,Screwdriver,wrench">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>List: #Tools#</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Expression</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>ListContains(Tools, "bar")</TD><TD>#ListContains(Tools, "bar")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListContains(Tools, "screw")</TD><TD>#ListContains(Tools, "screw")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListContains(Tools, "Screw")</TD><TD>#ListContains(Tools, "Screw")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListFind(Tools, "bar")</TD><TD>#ListFind(Tools, "bar")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ListContainsNoCase, ListFind, Find, ListValueCount
